why: A pose that did not minimize: a large positive total_score is the signature of unresolved clashes, and the most likely cause on this campaign is a ligand PyRosetta never had parameters for. Until commit 041caba none of the three Rosetta tools could pass -extra_res_fa at all, so a real ALR-ligand PDB would either raise in pose_from_pdb() or score like this. The gate catches the second case; nothing catches a ligand quietly dropped by -ignore_unrecognized_res, which is backlog B1.
